findings.evidence: Two Vue warnings persist at state 06 confirmation: 'Extraneous non-emits event listeners (addToCart, goToCart, startOrder, resetKiosk) were passed to component but could not be automatically inherited because component renders fragment or text root nodes. at <KioskConfirmationComponent orderNumber="A0024" orderTotal=2>'. Identical to run-1 (and run-2 did not flag it). The resetKiosk listener is the auto-return-to-idle hook — if it's not bound, the kiosk could stay stuck on the confirmation screen between customers. Visual screenshot 06 confirms confirmation renders correctly but the underlying emit binding is broken.
findings.fix_hint: In KioskConfirmationComponent.vue: declare emits: ['addToCart','goToCart','startOrder','resetKiosk'] OR wrap the template in a single root element. Verify the auto-reset timer still fires after declaring the emits.

Either route source=kiosk into Borne lane regardless of order_type, or remove the lane and surface source as a badge. findings.evidence: NEW finding. After the ACCEPT→PREPARING→PREPARED transitions, order N°A0024 / #100526263 is COMPLETELY ABSENT from the KDS screen. State 07 showed it in À emporter/Confirmées; state 09 (Toutes Les Commandes tab active per screenshot, purple highlight) shows only orders 240+241 — the freshly-prepared order has vanished from the view. The Préparations sidebar counter incremented Frites Seules 7→8 confirming the status DID transition (so this is NOT the run-2 C-017 'stuck in Confirmées' issue), but the kitchen staff has NO visibility on the prepared order anywhere on screen — no 'Prêts à servir' / 'Terminées' lane is rendered in the default 'Toutes Les Commandes' view. Meanwhile state 10 customer screen displays N°A0024 in the 'Prêt' column → customer is told the order is ready, but kitchen cannot reconcile / serve it from the default KDS dashboard. Different bug than run-2 (which was no-refresh) but equally bad UX.
findings.fix_hint: (1) Render a 'Prêts à servir' / 'Terminées' column in the 'Toutes Les Commandes' KDS view so PREPARED orders remain visible until DELIVERED. OR (2) auto-switch the operator to the 'Terminées' tab momentarily after a bump. OR (3) keep the order card in À emporter lane with a visual 'Prêt' badge until the cashier marks delivery. Verify with manager-grade UX review.

findings.evidence: NEW finding. Vue warn at state 01-pos-supervisor-baseline: 'Property "itemsRaw" was accessed during render but is not defined on instance. at <PosComponent onVnodeUnmounted=fn<onVnodeUnmounted> ref=Ref< undefined > >'. The PosComponent reads a non-existent reactive ref during render — likely a leftover from a recent refactor. Visible page renders OK but the warning indicates a latent template-vs-store binding mismatch that could throw on cold-paint of a different POS state (cart restore, draft order resume).
findings.fix_hint: Open resources/js/components/PosComponent.vue, search template for v-if/v-for/v-bind referencing itemsRaw. Either (a) declare const itemsRaw = computed(...) in <script setup>, (b) rename to existing prop, or (c) remove the binding. Add a smoke-test that fails on Vue warnings.

findings.evidence: NEW finding (data-flow correctness, not pricing). State 08 POS Suivi commandes shows N°A0024 (kiosk order 263) in the 'À ENVOYER' column at 2,00€. State 07 KDS shows the SAME order already in 'À emporter / Confirmées' (= accepted by kitchen). The two surfaces disagree on the order's lifecycle position: KDS says 'Confirmée / awaiting preparation start', POS suivi says 'À envoyer = needs to be sent to kitchen'. Either the POS column semantics map 'À envoyer = not yet KDS-acked' (in which case state 07 should show no card) or the lane logic is wrong. Run-1 C-002 (totals were 0) IS fixed — totals now read 2,00€ correctly. New issue is the cross-surface lane mismatch. NOTE: state 08 was captured BEFORE the prête transition (state 09), so this is NOT a stale-snapshot issue.
findings.fix_hint: Document the canonical mapping {kiosk_order.status_id} -> {KDS lane} -> {POS suivi column}. Likely fix: when KDS acknowledges (state CONFIRMED), POS suivi should move the row from À ENVOYER to EN PRÉPARATION simultaneously. Or relabel À ENVOYER to 'NOUVEAU' to clarify it's the freshly-arrived state regardless of KDS ack.
